svg.text: Server Side — one deployable application (Modular Monolith)
Caddy (HTTPS) · Auth & Role Guards · CSRF · Validation
routes each request to the controller of its module
Business Modules — each module is a vertical slice that owns its data
Module communication — modules never touch each other's tables
① Sync calls through the public API: Catalog → ProjectSnapshot · Catalog → AgencyService.getBranding() · Sales Contacts → SalesContactReader
Map & Search / Projects & Units → ProjectReadModel · Platform Admin → AgencyService.suspend() · Agency & Team → InvitationService
② Events on the in-process Event Bus: AgencySuspended → end sessions · ProjectUnpublished → mark catalog items · UnitPriceChanged → history
Shared Kernel — infrastructure only, no business rules
Every module uses these services; none of them depends on a module.
Each module keeps its own table definitions (catalog.schema.ts, content.schema.ts …) so ownership is visible in the code.
puts on the queue; never shares memory
one database, every table owned by one module:
External services: OpenFreeMap (map tiles, loaded by the browser and the worker) · SMTP provider (email)
